cards.explanation: The answer is to cross to the other side of the sea. Jesus sees a large crowd around Him, and He gives orders to cross to the other side of the sea (Matthew 8:18). The text doesn't say why He gives the order, so I won't guess. I just know a crowd that big would have me hiding behind my cookie boxes.

The answer is a place to lay His head. Jesus says, “Foxes have dens and birds of the air have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay His head.” (Matthew 8:20) Even a fox gets a den and a bird gets a nest. I know a little about not having a place to rest, friends, because I spent years in the back of a drawer.
The answer is False. The disciple says, “Lord, first let me go and bury my father.” (Matthew 8:21) Burying his father is the request he makes. Saying goodbye to his family isn't in it, friends.

The answer is that Jesus tells him to follow Him and let the dead bury their own dead. Jesus says, “Follow Me, and let the dead bury their own dead.” (Matthew 8:22) That's a tough one, and I think it's a heavy moment. The text doesn't give us more, so I'll leave it right where it is.

The answer is sleeping. The boat is engulfed by the waves, “But Jesus was sleeping.” (Matthew 8:24) Waves everywhere, and He's asleep. The only thing I've ever slept through, friends, was my own alarm clock.

The answer is that they ask Him to save them because they are perishing. The disciples go and wake Him, saying, “Lord, save us! We are perishing!” (Matthew 8:25) They call Him Lord and they ask Him to save them. Jesus' next question, “why are you so afraid?”, shows they were afraid (Matthew 8:26).

The answer is True. Jesus replies, “You of little faith, why are you so afraid?” (Matthew 8:26) He asks them why they are so afraid. I think that's a question worth sitting with, bakers, and I won't add more than the text gives.

The answer is False. After Jesus rebukes the winds and the sea, “…it was perfectly calm.” (Matthew 8:26) Not a little rough and not mostly calm, friends. PERFECTLY calm. Not one ripple left to complain about.
The answer is amazed. “The men were amazed…” (Matthew 8:27). The sea is perfectly calm, and they're amazed. I think I would have been standing there with my mustache hanging open.

The answer is “What kind of man is this?” The men were amazed and asked, “What kind of man is this? Even the winds and the sea obey Him!” (Matthew 8:27) They'd just seen the storm go quiet. I'd be asking questions too, friends, probably with a trembling mustache.
